copyReadySnippets: This repo opening session is limited to backend alpha shell proof. No live customer data, production billing keys, source workbooks, certificates, or commercial exports are approved for this PR.
This draft PR creates the backend alpha shell, evidence packet, and controlled repo proof only. It does not launch production SaaS or import live customer records.
Rollback is to close the draft PR, delete the alpha branch, and recreate the private repo if visibility, secret, or data-leak proof fails.
Closeout status records what passed, what was deferred, what remains blocked, who owns the next step, and whether this repo day is go, hold, or no-go.
handoff: v131 turns the day-one script into a proof exporter for the private backend repo.
The exporter defines evidence markdown files, screenshot names, command transcript slots, PR body sections, owner approval notes, closeout packet, and quality gates.
The static demo still cannot create real screenshots, real GitHub URLs, real workflow names, or real signoffs; it now makes the empty proof packet ready for those facts.
v132 can bundle repo name, owner roles, issue wave, PR body, proof artifacts, and closeout notes into one GitHub Repo Opening Packet.
